faces.name: Nexus Mentality
faces.oracleText:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Move all counters from target nonland permanent you control onto another target nonland permanent you control.
• Remove all counters from target nonland permanent you control. Draw a card for each counter removed this way.

faces.name: Nexus Wardens
faces.oracleText:
Reach
Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, you gain 2 life.

faces.name: Nexus of Becoming
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw a card. Then you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand. If you do, create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 3/3 Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.

faces.name: Nexus of Fate
faces.oracleText:
Take an extra turn after this one.
If Nexus of Fate would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal Nexus of Fate and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
